subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 01, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 01, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We're excited to share the latest updates from the AcreetionOS project. As we continue to build and improve our community-driven, user-friendly Linux distribution based on Arch Linux, we're grateful for your support and participation.

In the past week, we've seen some exciting developments in the world of open-source software. OpenShot 4.0 has been released, offering improved video editing capabilities. The Netdev 0x1A conference has also made its videos and slides available online, providing valuable insights into the latest networking developments. Additionally, security updates have been issued by Debian and Fedora, ensuring our community stays informed and secure.

On the AcreetionOS front, we've been busy with various commits and updates. Our GitHub repositories have seen activity from cobra3282000, natalie, and spivanatalie64, with changes ranging from intelligence sync to ci and release management. We're grateful for the hard work and dedication of our contributors.

As we move forward, we're committed to maintaining our focus on privacy and sovereignty. Our distribution remains free from telemetry, ensuring that users have complete control over their data. We're proud to be a community-driven project, and your involvement is crucial to our success.

We're also excited to announce that our GitLab instance is now available, providing a platform for collaboration and community engagement. We invite you to join us on GitLab and participate in the discussions and projects that shape the future of AcreetionOS.

In the coming weeks, we'll be working on various projects, including the development of new features and the improvement of existing ones. We'll keep you updated on our progress and invite your feedback and suggestions.

As always, we appreciate your support and enthusiasm for the AcreetionOS project. Your contributions, whether through code, documentation, or simply spreading the word, make a significant impact on our community.

If you're interested in getting involved or learning more about AcreetionOS, please visit our website or join our Discord server. We're always happy to welcome new members and provide guidance to those interested in contributing.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We look forward to continuing our journey together and creating a better, more private, and more sovereign Linux distribution.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift, Co-Lead Developers of AcreetionOS
